20452.tail: The classical cut needs no accessories to read as cheongsam - the collar and closure line do the identifying - which is why the dress-plus-thong format works as the family's simplest entry.
20452.short_add: The simplest entry in a four-listing cheongsam family.

20279.tail: The sweater-and-stockings pairing arrives matched, which is the set's whole convenience - knit costumes usually leave the legs as an exercise, and this one closes that gap in the bag.
20279.short_add: Stockings arrive matched instead of left as an exercise.

20345.tail: Gray nylon mesh with the widest single-size claim on the site - 40-70 kg - and the fabric's stretch is what backs the number; the sheerness is the register, not the compromise.
20345.short_add: The stretch backs the range claim honestly.

20383.tail: Four pieces with the theme carried by headwear and neck ring rather than print means the costume cues are removable - plain jumpsuit for one occasion, full cat read for another.
20383.short_add: Costume cues removable for two occasions in one.

22056.tail: The waist seal is what separates tutor from generic office - one accessory decision doing the genre work - and the M-L run covers the heavier band most two-size listings quietly skip.
22056.short_add: One accessory does the genre work, sizes to 145 lbs.

21013.tail: The bow sits above the bell in the classic arrangement, both anchored to a real-leather band - the formula is old, the construction is honest, and white or black splits the register.
21013.short_add: Old formula, honest leather, two clean registers.

21014.tail: Stone-set wings on a butterfly focal piece - the detail that separates this from flat stamped charms - and the white-black split covers fairy and gothic in one listing with the same band.
21014.short_add: Stone-set wings rather than flat stamped charms.

19394.tail: The top does the design work in a two-piece set, and the as-pictured colorway keeps the decision simple - the nightclub genre stripped to its working parts at the category's lower price tier.
19394.short_add: The nightclub genre at its working minimum.

20101.tail: The headband toggles the read - on for nurse, off for lingerie - which makes one purchase serve the party and the after without a costume change in between.

20122.tail: Top, skirt, thong - the working three of the police genre with no hat to have opinions about - and polyester washes cold and dries overnight, keeping the set in rotation.
20122.short_add: No hat to argue about; cold wash keeps it rotating.

20686.tail: Sheer fabric puts the cow print in lingerie weight, and the apron over the jumpsuit is what makes the maid read - animal print and costume genre sharing one construction.
20686.short_add: Animal print and maid genre in one sheer build.

20460.tail: Black, pink, or white on the same lace cut with the hat included - the two-piece nurse format at its widest color run, and the cutouts only work because the fabric is lace.
20460.short_add: Cutouts exist because the lace allows them.

18990.tail: Cow print in milk-silk lace is the friendly animal entry - less commitment than leopard, more personality than a solid - and the sleeve piece extends the set past the dress-only default.
18990.short_add: The friendly animal print, softer than leopard.

21011.tail: The fixed charm means nothing swings or catches, which matters under clothing as much as during wear - a small design decision that separates daily-wear chokers from costume ones.
21011.short_add: Fixed charm suits daily wear under clothing.

21139.tail: The stretch band is the whole product: it holds at the thigh through an evening and forgives the sizing question entirely, in the three shades lingerie sets actually run.
21139.short_add: The band forgives sizing across the whole evening.

21167.tail: Punk hardware with a heart centerpiece is the genre collision that makes the collar read twice - once as costume, once as intimate accessory - and three shades cover both moods.
21167.short_add: Reads costume and intimate in one collision.

21168.tail: Openwork heart plus a 110 cm chain is the gothic-leaning end of the chained-collar format, with the collar at 45 cm printed for checking - the measurements are the courtesy here.
21168.short_add: Gothic-leaning chain with printed fit numbers.

21176.tail: Leather instead of elastic changes everything about how a garter wears - it holds shape rather than stretching into it - and the heart accent keeps the firm line from reading severe.
21176.short_add: Firm line softened by the heart accent.

21257.tail: Two styles differing only in length is the honest version of a product line - 46 versus 48 cm, no pretend features - and the leather handle is what makes it a real accessory.
21257.short_add: An honest two-option line with real build.

20584.tail: The magnolia print does the designing so the cut stays simple - wrap, tie, wear - and the matching thong closes the set without a single additional decision for the buyer.
20584.short_add: Print does the designing; the buyer just ties.

22022.tail: Mesh over a bodysuit base is why the skirt can afford its sheerness - the fit lives underneath - and the lace tassel hem gives the photographs movement the plain versions lack.
22022.short_add: Bodysuit base makes the sheer skirt wearable.

19337.tail: Chiffon makes this the long-wear bunny option - no boning, no hardware, fitted drape - and the neckband is soft-sided, which reads the same at a party and sits differently by midnight.
19337.short_add: The long-wear option with no hardware digging.

20052.tail: Glasses for the teacher read, a folder for the office one, or nothing at all - the set supports three levels of commitment to the costume without changing a single piece.
20052.short_add: Three prop levels, zero required, one set.

20578.tail: The rope-tie bow adjusts to the wearer rather than the reverse - the one structural demand the costume makes - and sheer polyester keeps the office silhouette in lingerie territory.
20578.short_add: One adjustable tie, lingerie-weight fabric throughout.

20636.tail: Four pieces including the hat most listings drop, and printed bust and waist numbers that settle the fit before checkout - the police costume at its most specified in this category.
20636.short_add: Hat included and fit numbers printed at checkout.

19730.tail: Woven jacquard versus printed florals is a close-range difference and a durability difference - the pattern is in the fabric rather than on it, in the two colorways that outlast trends.
19730.short_add: Pattern woven in, not printed on, two shades.

21010.tail: Cutwork rather than charms means nothing dangles - the star pattern is negative space in the leather itself, and white or black keeps the band universal against any outfit collar line.
21010.short_add: Negative-space design with nothing to dangle.

19348.tail: Two costume references resolved in a single garment - maid at the neck ring, bunny in the one-piece line - and the open construction is named plainly in the listing, no surprises at unboxing.
19348.short_add: Two themes named plainly, no unboxing surprises.

20391.tail: Hair band and outfit, two pieces, on in seconds - the deep-V does the design work fuller sets assign to aprons, and the black-white scheme is the genre's own default palette.
20391.short_add: Genre-default palette with a two-piece dress code.

20486.tail: Socks in the bag close the outfit question, and the belly-pocket silhouette frames rather than covers - printed bust and waist ranges behind the one-size claim the way charts should.
20486.short_add: Socks included and fit numbers backing the size.

20556.tail: The oversized top is the engineering behind the 40-70 kg claim - it forgives where fitted tops would gamble - and black keeps the set in the sleek register the genre's plaid versions skip.
20556.short_add: The top forgives; the range claim is honest.

20085.tail: Velvet photographs richer than polyester ever manages, and the shawl carries the character from across a room - the fairytale costume at the fabric tier the story deserves.
20085.short_add: Fabric tier the fairytale actually deserves.
